purpose: Teach: 美奈子/貞子/アヤ/マサ/わらしべ/ガンモ/キチン/逸品

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお友達の美奈子さんと打ち合わせされてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was having a meeting with Minako-san, our friend.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle delivery, like sharing a casual detail with curiosity behind it. Soft, unhurried pace. A mother's natural way of passing along small news.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「リング」の貞子のホラー漫画見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched the horror manga about Sadako from The Ring together.
lines.style: Bright, direct announcement. Quick opening, eager energy. Small boy sharing something that mattered to him. Clean, unfiltered enthusiasm without performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「アヤちゃんの絵が上手」って褒めてらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was saying that Aya-chan's drawings are really good.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly wistful. Measured pace, like she's reflecting on what he said rather than simply reporting it. Warm but thoughtful — noticing something kind about him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんのお友達のマサ兄ちゃんと釣り行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went fishing with Masa-nii, Dad's friend.
lines.style: Eager, immediate report. Light, uncomplicated delivery — a boy excited to share what he did. Quick pace, simple pride in the outing. No self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「わらしべ長者の昔話」を読み聞かせて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is reading you the old story about the Boy with the Magic Wand.
lines.style: Warm, present-tense observation like it's happening now or ongoing. Gentle, almost tender on the storytelling detail. Reflective pace — she's noticing something precious about him as a father.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとガンモ、つまりがんもどきの煮物を食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I had ganmo — you know, that tofu cake in broth — for dinner.
lines.style: Eager, warm report. Quick, guileless opening. The proud detail of what he ate, delivered with clear, simple joy. A six-year-old's unfiltered delight in sharing a meal.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「キチン質のサプリは関節に良い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was saying that chitin supplements are good for your joints.
lines.style: Steady, reflective delivery of information. Measured pace, like she's turning over what he said. A hint of care underneath — noticing he's thinking about health, about him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんから逸品の和菓子を頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad gave me some really special wagashi — like a treasure.
lines.style: Pure joy, unhurried. Warm opening, then a gentle dip of reverence on 'treasure.' The pride of receiving something special, delivered with a child's honest gratitude. Soft trailing finish.
